article.label: A STORY FROM BRYME
article.headline: The Life of an Addicted Gambler: The Wins Everyone Sees, the Losses Nobody Counts
article.teaser: The ticket everyone celebrates is the one that keeps the bets coming. Behind it is a history of deposits, loans and promises that nobody counted.
article.coverAlt: A man sits alone in a betting shop at night, studying a paper slip in his hands, while a bank of old television screens on the wall shows football matches
